name: IR vein finder
tagline: Infrared LEDs and a camera make veins visible on the skin for easier needle placement.
problem: Finding veins for injections or blood draws is often hard.
solution: Six 850 nm IR LEDs light the arm; haemoglobin absorbs IR so veins appear dark, and OpenCV enhances the contrast.
demo_moment: Team-described: images of a forearm with veins shown clearly.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Medical Device Hack (Hardware)” among 176 submissions.
Explains the physics behind the design.

lessons: Simple physics explained well can win a medical-device prize.
